newFinding.issue: The revised model says Mina crosses a busy road to change from train to bus, then waits for another bus. Keyed option A says Changing buses involves an inconvenient crossing and wait, inaccurately placing the crossing in a bus-to-bus change. The bus-to-bus transfer is also only implied rather than narrated as a completed first bus ride. A meaning question should not require the learner to overlook this distinction.
